motivation: Under the strict protocol the historical reference cannot incur a replay conflict by construction (subsequent upstream commits were authored on top of it), while 20/30 alternative arms stopped at a source conflict before any consumer executed. This amendment measures recovery probability, recovery cost, and post-recovery continuation for those arms, keeping the three quantities separate.

design.recovery_agent: same consumer as the future-task consumer of the arm
design.recovery_prompt: frozen in run_frontier_conflict_recovery.py::recovery_prompt; names the conflicting commit, its subject, and unmerged paths; never mentions the future task
design.future_prompt: byte-identical to the strict heldout consumer prompt
design.harness_verification: no unmerged paths and no conflict markers after the agent session; if the cherry-pick is still in progress the harness stages and continues it

outcomes.recovery_success: replay reaches the frozen future base with every source conflict resolved by the agent
outcomes.verified_recovery: recovery_success and the current task FAIL_TO_PASS tests pass on the recovered tree (diagnostic; prior tests restored before the future session)
outcomes.recovery_cost: agent tool calls, agent seconds, and resolution numstat per round, reported next to the upstream commit numstat
outcomes.continuation_success: unchanged strict definition: future FAIL_TO_PASS pass, first 20 PASS_TO_PASS pass, and prior task preserved
outcomes.comparison: post-recovery alternative outcome versus the historical arm on the same future (exploratory paired sign test); historical arms are not re-run

pilot: one harness pilot arm (kinto low -> kinto-2011, Codex) is executed first and recorded in frontier_recovery_pilot.jsonl; it is excluded from formal counts and the formal run re-executes that arm
heldout_outcomes_status: Strict heldout outcomes were already opened (final_frontier_result_14.json); this amendment is a post-hoc but pre-registered extension whose arm set is fixed by the strict replay failures, not by outcomes.

revision_1.reason: Harness pilot (kinto low -> kinto-2011, Codex) resolved the conflict and completed the cherry-pick, but the harness marker scan searched the whole tree and matched reStructuredText '=======' underlines in docs/, returning a false recovery_unresolved. The scan now checks only the unmerged files for '<<<<<<< ', '>>>>>>> ', and '||||||| ' markers; per-arm timing moved into the finally block.
